# slashmail

> slashmail is a free, open-source command-line email client for IMAP. It searches, reads, drafts, replies, moves, deletes (to Trash), marks, counts, and exports mail, prints JSON for scripts, and ships an agent skill so AI agents such as Claude Code or Codex can manage email. It never sends mail: drafts and replies are saved to the Drafts folder.

slashmail works with IMAP servers that accept a password: Gmail (with an app password), Proton Mail Bridge, Yahoo, iCloud, Fastmail, Dovecot, and others. Outlook.com and Microsoft 365 are not supported, since they only accept OAuth over IMAP. It is written in Rust, runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows, and is licensed under MIT or Apache-2.0.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mwmdev/slashmail/main/README.md): install, configuration, every command and option, examples, safety, troubleshooting
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mwmdev/slashmail/main/skills/slashmail/SKILL.md): instructions that teach an AI agent to use slashmail safely
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mwmdev/slashmail/main/CHANGELOG.md): changes in each release

## Tutorials

- [Use slashmail with Gmail](https://www.slashmail.io/tutorials/gmail.html): app password, configuration, labels as folders
- [Use slashmail with Proton Mail Bridge](https://www.slashmail.io/tutorials/proton-bridge.html): Bridge password, local IMAP connection, search limits
- [Manage your mail with an AI agent](https://www.slashmail.io/tutorials/ai-agent.html): install the skill, approvals, privacy
- [Read and answer email with a local model](https://www.slashmail.io/tutorials/local-model.html): Ollama or LM Studio, nothing sent to an AI provider

## Optional

- [Releases](https://github.com/mwmdev/slashmail/releases): prebuilt binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows
- [crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/slashmail): install with `cargo install slashmail`
